summary: Genenta Science S.p.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting receipt of a Nasdaq letter confirming regained compliance with the minimum bid price requirement of $1.00 per share. The company had been notified of non-compliance on April 10, 2026. After 10 consecutive business days (June 1–12, 2026) with the closing bid price of its ADSs at or above $1.00, Nasdaq formally closed the matter. This is a routine compliance update, not a special-situation transaction or event. No deal terms, premium, or structural changes apply. The filing contains no actionable special-situation catalyst.
